question: Can you tell me the numeric value of the active council district in Austin which has the highest number of bike trips that start and end within the same district, but not at the same station?
sql:
SELECT sd.council_district, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_stations` sd 
  ON t.start_station_id = sd.station_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_stations` se
  ON CAST(t.end_station_id AS INT64) = se.station_id
WHERE sd.status = 'active'
  AND se.status = 'active'
  AND sd.council_district = se.council_district
  AND t.start_station_id != CAST(t.end_station_id AS INT64)
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.start_time) = 2018
GROUP BY sd.council_district
ORDER BY cnt DESC
